title: R2 uploads for the NI dispensary districts and the Towns Improvement Act towns (9 map editions)
summary: The upload and post-upload half of the dispensary-district and Towns Improvement Act town editions staged by ni-plu-dispensary-towns-2026-11-02 and committed in 2fc8ce45e1. Describes what the hand-written upload.ps1, UPLOAD.txt and post-upload.txt of D:\civgraph-intake\batch-2026-11-05 did.

personalData.note: Boundaries and catalogue entries only; no names or addresses of people.

sources.title: Intake batch ni-plu-dispensary-towns-2026-11-02 (sources and method in its README.md)

operations.note: 3 dispensary-district editions (26 MB each) and 6 town editions.
The DED lookup CSV of the dispensary districts (upload-fgb-r2 sends only .fgb).
Content cache tokens on the catalogue's FGB URLs, now that the files exist on R2.

Uses the cdn-range-report.json the upload's CDN check wrote; unverified layers are skipped. No alias layer points at any of the 9 (checked 2026-11-05). Do not run build-test-pmtiles.mjs --force for these layers afterwards: it resets tileUrl to the local path.
Should list only the metadata changes from the switch and the ?v= tokens.
Catalogue cards show broken images until these exist; regen --download reads the FGBs from R2.

beforeUpload.note: 2 of 65 checks fail until the upload and switch are done; everything else passes (catalogue check, test:catalogue 49/49, the rebuild's browser subset 17/17, stamp-map-cache-tokens --check).
details: check:test (validate-test-cdn-manifest): for each of the 9 layers "missing tilePackage.byteRangeVerifiedAt" and "missing successful CDN range verification report row"; "CDN range report verified 873/882"
check:test2 (PMTiles/CDN validation): for each of the 9 layers "PMTiles tileUrl is not a promoted data.civgraph.net PMTiles URL"

notes: Commit what the post-upload steps change (render/metadata/maps-test.json, cdn-upload-manifest.json, cdn-range-report.json, the ?v= tokens in maps.json and the catalogue, the thumbnails manifest, rebuilt outputs), then ask the owner before bash .claude/publish/publish.sh.
The batch folder also holds gazette-date-decisions.csv (the Belfast Gazette made/in-force date review, applied by hand and committed separately) and drafts/ for the publish verifier.
